decisions.reason: Prior adjudication files do not yet exist; the old Chan Wing Yan cache and collection timecap are unrelated history. In the verified 98-page Chan On Ying (2021) thesis (osf.io/u59ab), page 6 explicitly identifies Young & Saxe (2011), 'When ignorance is no excuse: Different roles for intent across moral domains', Cognition, 120(2), 202-214, DOI 10.1016/j.cognition.2011.04.005, as the sole target research article, re-testing Experiments 1A and 2 to 4 in a combined mixed-design experiment (pp. 7, 11-15, 17-18). Other cited works—including Sweetman & Newman (2020) on Experiment 1B (p. 10) and Parkinson & Byrne (2016/2018) on moral responsibility (pp. 11, 16-17, 45)—serve as background or extension motivation rather than re-tested targets, and the cached 2egqr Stage 1 draft is not used as evidence.
